verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded documents a webhook subscription API that registers outbound HTTP callbacks. Its docs cover creating subscriptions by subscription_types, verifying the endpoint with a verification_token, HMAC signing of event payloads, named events such as payroll.paid, and a webhooks health-check endpoint. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery and reliability, and a documented retry/delivery policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Create a webhook subscription to receive events of the specified subscription_types whenever there is a state change.
A webhook is an HTTP request that delivers information about an event as it happens.
This `verify` endpoint needs to be called with `verification_token` before webhook events can be sent to the registered webhook URL.
Gusto computes a hash message authentication code (HMAC) of the event payload using the verification_token
Returns the health status (`healthy`, `unhealthy`, or `unknown`) of the webhooks system based on the last ten minutes of activity.
